declarations.description:
One Blip icon as inline SVG in light DOM, so it takes the page's colour and the .pp-icon size. Markup that
already holds the <svg> (rendered on the server) is adopted, not replaced.
declarations.name: PixelIcon

members.name: name
members.description: The icon to draw. An unknown name draws nothing.

members.name: label
members.description: Names the icon for assistive technology. Leave it out when the icon only decorates text that says the same.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The icon to draw. An unknown name draws nothing and warns once (PP-I001).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Names the icon for assistive technology; without it the icon is aria-hidden.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Twice the size: 24 pixels square instead of 12.
